fact_text: Judge the returns of any asset class over a long horizon, about 25 years, rather than short windows, because short windows give a misleading picture.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under the rule of 72, an asset compounding at 18% a year doubles in about four years, while compounding at 12-14% takes roughly five to six years.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Each doubling multiplies capital by two, so five doublings turn an amount into 32 times its start and three doublings turn it into 8 times.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Long-run equity returns come from listed businesses that grow profits and reinvest them; shareholders earn that growth as partners rather than by frequent trading.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Owning shares in many businesses lowers the risk of depending on one company, which the analyst cites as a reason the stock market suits long-term savers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst cites Warren Buffett's view that retail investors have a lower chance than professionals of finding the best IPOs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Owners selling shares in an IPO want a good price for a business they built, so IPO shares are less likely to be undervalued than shares already trading.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A broker earns about 1% commission on IPO subscriptions versus about 0.15% on ordinary buy or sell trades, roughly seven times more, which drives IPO promotion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: IPO gains measured from the offer price mislead in bull markets, since oversubscription gives small allotments; the realistic baseline is the price at which an investor can buy the desired size after trading starts.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Bull-market conditions hold while deposit rates stay in the single digits up to about 10-11%, and turn off as rates climb to 13-15%, because deposits then compete with equity returns.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A one-point rate rise from a low base of about 8-9% changes the equity regime far less than the same one-point rise from a high base.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A war-driven oil shock can lead the central bank to raise rates as a precaution, and such precautionary hikes tend to reverse once oil prices and the shock normalise.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When rates rise, rate-sensitive cyclicals and autos are typically marked down while banks look safer; the analyst reasons that quality rate-sensitive firms become attractive for medium-term holding once priced low enough.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: After a 50-60% rally in six to twelve months, the analyst's reasoning favours holding 10-20% of savings in cash to buy a likely correction; with bear-market risk the equity share should be cut.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Higher international oil prices lift upstream profits for oil and gas producers, but through different routes: gas-policy-linked earnings for some companies and oil revenue for others.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under the 2012 petroleum policy gas prices move with oil, whereas under older policies gas prices stall at a ceiling even as oil keeps rising.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: About half of Mari Energies' gas is priced under the 2012 petroleum policy, so a higher oil price lifts its gas price and profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari Energies' nine-for-one bonus issue (800%) means pre-bonus share prices must be multiplied by nine before they are compared with current prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: About half of OGDC's revenue comes from oil, and most of its gas fields sit under older policies, so its profit responds more to oil prices than to gas prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For a one-to-two-year holding a low-P/E producer may suit better; for a long holding, a stronger long-term operating record and field quality matter more than the current multiple.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: As war-driven uncertainty fades, oil-linked stocks may not outperform as much in a broad market recovery.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For petrochemical makers whose selling prices follow international product prices, electricity and gas cost is the main controllable driver of profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When gas for a captive gas power plant becomes expensive, a chemical maker's own power generation can lose most of its profit, since the cost advantage disappears.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When import duties on competing chemical products fall, local producers must cut prices to match imports, which squeezes their margins.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: To value Lotte Chemical after acquiring EPCL, combine the two businesses, then test the purchase price and the debt needed against the combined future profit.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PABC is described as the dominant maker of beverage cans for Pakistan's soft-drink bottlers, with a plant in Faisalabad and capacity above one billion cans.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PABC's profits depend heavily on can exports to Afghanistan, so a border closure cuts its volume and profit sharply.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Selling cans in other export markets, such as Sri Lanka, earns thinner margins because established competing can plants already serve those markets.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lower IMF-agreed import duties on imported cans reduce the price protection on PABC's local sales, adding a second margin squeeze.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If the Afghan border reopens, the analyst views PABC as the largest single beneficiary, ahead of cement and pharmaceutical exporters.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'MARI Crash, Retirement Plan, Blue Chips & SIP - Honest Q&A' (YouTube transcript, undated)
